#!/bin/sh
# set13 lab shim (disposable guest): every call is logged, then the real systemctl runs with the same arguments.
# While /run/set13-lab/fail-daemon-reload names the caller's parent PID (the Agent), that process's next `daemon-reload` fails once.
printf '%s systemctl ppid=%s comm=%s args=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%NZ)" "$PPID" "$(cat /proc/$PPID/comm 2>/dev/null)" "$*" >> /run/set13-lab/calls.log
if [ "$1" = daemon-reload ] && [ -f /run/set13-lab/fail-daemon-reload ] && [ "$(cat /run/set13-lab/fail-daemon-reload)" = "$PPID" ]; then
  rm -f /run/set13-lab/fail-daemon-reload
  printf '%s systemctl ppid=%s injected-failure daemon-reload rc=1\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%NZ)" "$PPID" >> /run/set13-lab/calls.log
  echo "Failed to reload daemon: set13 lab preparation (one injected failure)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
exec /usr/bin/systemctl "$@"

#!/bin/sh
# set13 lab shim (disposable guest): every call is logged with its exit status; the real systemd-analyze runs.
printf '%s systemd-analyze ppid=%s comm=%s args=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%NZ)" "$PPID" "$(cat /proc/$PPID/comm 2>/dev/null)" "$*" >> /run/set13-lab/calls.log
/usr/bin/systemd-analyze "$@"
rc=$?
printf '%s systemd-analyze ppid=%s rc=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%NZ)" "$PPID" "$rc" >> /run/set13-lab/calls.log
exit $rc
